title: Prod apply denied after the WIF hardening PR
scenario: Every foundation apply on main has failed since this morning with Permission 'iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken' denied, while PR plans still work. The org policy rollout InfoSec wants today is stuck behind it. You get the workflow, the Workload Identity Federation Terraform, the run log, decoded OIDC claims of two runs, audit log entries, the merged security PR and the on-call thread, plus a local WIF simulator.
task: Reproduce both runs with make repro and find which step fails: STS exchange or impersonation
Find the root cause in the config and the evidence; rule out the red herrings in the thread
Fix infra/wif.tf.json so only the protected production apply can impersonate tf-apply
Root cause, evidence and the note for the PR in ANSWER.md
acceptance: The production apply job gets tf-apply; PR, feature-branch, staging, other-repo and fork tokens do not
PR plans keep working with tf-plan
No pool-wide or repository-wide binding on tf-apply; the owner condition stays; the apply job keeps its environment
Root cause with quoted evidence in ANSWER.md
